about: Where the kit's migration order comes from (kit.migration-order-source.v1): the comparator wrangler applies D1 migrations with, mirrored exactly by packages/core/src/migration-order.js. Numeric prefix by parseInt semantics on the text before the first underscore, files without a number last, ties broken by plain string comparison; two files with one number therefore have a defined order (number, then name).

wrangler.rule: leadingMigrationNumber = parseInt(firstSegment.split("_")[0], 10); numbers first, NaN last, then a plain < / > string compare as the tie-break
